content: 'Ũkxape max xop, Topa te yũmũ'ã hãpxop xohix 'ãktux xex. 'Ãpu yũmũ hãpkummuk mĩy'ax kux, puyĩy Topa yũmũg kuxa pix, tu yũmũg putup'ax kummuk nõã'. 'Ãpu yũmũ hãmmãynãg mĩy, nũy Topa 'ãpax max.
Pu yã 'ãkuxa 'ũkxax. 'Ũgmũ'ãte tikmũ'ũn kummugã 'ohnãg, tu tikmũ'ũn koxyõy 'ohnãg, tu tikmũ'ũn yõg hãpxop pop 'ohnãg.
'A 'ãte hãm'ãktux'ah 'ãxop kummuk. Pa hõmã 'ãte hãm'ãktux, xix hõnhã hãm'ãktux 'ãte 'ãxop xak, yã hõnhã 'ãxop xak, xix pexkox tu 'ãxop xak putup kamah.
'Ũgkuxa yũm 'ãxop kopah, tu hãmpekpaxex 'ãxop max. Yõgnũ hãpkummuk pip, pak kuxa yũm, tuk kuxa hittup xexka'.
Hõmãg mũg mõg hãpxexka Mãxenõn tu', tu mõktuk mũg mõxaha', hak mũ yõg hãpkummuk punethok pip, yã tikmũ'ũn tek mũg kute'ex kummuk, hak mũg kuxanõg.
Pa Topa te tikmũ'ũn kuxa hittupmãhã', tuk mũg kuxa hittupmãhã kamah. Yã Tit nũn, nũy 'ũgkuxa hittupmã'.

Yã Tit xupep, yĩg mũg kuxa hittup. Yã 'ãxop max, yĩy Tit kuxa hittup, hu 'ã nõm 'ãktux, yĩg mũg kuxa hittup kamah. Tit te hãm'ãktux 'ãxop tek xak punethok, tu 'ãxop te nõm tik kummuk tu yãyhãhup, tu 'ãxop tep-tup punethok, nũy 'ã hã 'ãtehet.
Hõmã 'ãte 'ãxop mãnõg tappet hã, yĩy 'ãxop kuxa hittup 'ohnãg. Pa puxix, 'ũmax tappet. 'Ok pe' kummuk 'ãkuxa hittup 'ohnãg? 'Ãmhok. Yã' max. Yã' max tappet.
Hõnhã 'ũgkuxa hittup. 'Ok 'ãkuxa hittup 'ohnãg, 'ũyĩg kuxa hittup? 'Ãmhok. Pa 'ãkuxa hittup 'ohnãg, hu hãpkummuk mĩy'ax kuxyãhã'. Topa teptup 'ãxop kuxa hittup 'ohnãg, nũy hãpkummuk mĩy'ax kuxyã'.

Yã Topa tep-tup 'ãxop kuxa hittup 'ohnãg, nũy hãpkummuk mĩy'ax kuxyã, ha Topa te 'ãkuxa kummuk xit'ax. Yã hãmmax, 'ãxop kuxa hittup 'ohnãg, yã' max. Pax xa kuxa hittup 'ohnãg te' kuxa mãm hok xop putuk, puxix tu' kummuk. Yã' kuxa hittup 'ohnãg te tikmũ'ũn kix.

Pẽnã', Topa te hãpxop max mĩy, 'ĩhã 'ãkuxa hittup 'ohnãg. 'Ãxop te hãmmax xak punethok, tup-tup punethok, pu tikmũ'ũn yũmmũg 'ãxop te hãpxe'e mĩy. 'Ãxop te hãpkummuk mĩy'ax putup nõg xexka', tu nõm hãpkummuk mĩy'ax yĩpkutuk xexka', tu 'ãxop tek xak punethok. 'Ãxop te nõm hãpkummuk mĩy'ax yãnãn mõ'ka'ok, yã nõm tik kummuk yõg hãpkummuk mĩy'ax yãnãn mõ'ka'ok. Tikmũ'ũn te' yũmmũg 'ãxop te hãpxe'e xohix mĩy.

Yã hõmã 'ãte xa tappet kax'ãmi, xayĩy 'ãxop yũmmũg 'ãxop tek mũg putuppax, tu Topap-tuppax kamah. Hã kaxĩy 'ãte xa tappet kax'ãmi'. Nõm tik kummuk te' tut mũtik nõm, tu' tak pu hupmãhã'. Pa hã kaxĩy 'ãte xa' kax'ãmi 'ohnãg.
Hõnhã 'ũgmũg kuxa hittup. Yã 'ãxop te Tito kuxa hittupmãhã', yĩg mũg kuxa hittup punethok kamah.
Hõmã 'ãte Tit pu hãm'ãktux 'ãxop max. Hamũn, hõnhã 'ãte hãmpekpaxex 'ãxop max. 'Ũgmũ'ãte 'ãxop pu hãpxe'e 'ãktux mõkumakmõg, tu Tit pu hãm'ãktux 'ãxop max.
Ha Tit te 'ãxop putuppax nõy nã' mõg, tu' yũmmũg 'ãxop yĩpkox pip, tu Tit yõg hãm'ãktux 'ãpak, tu' mĩy.
